items.description: Source associations retain their action_index, literal date and bill-family generation/path. The vote itself belongs to roll-call-votes. A referenced bill may be absent from local bill profiles.

properties.description: All pinned bill-action references matching this roll call by congress/chamber/session/roll number; null means no matching source reference. Raw bill_id remains separate.

customProperties.value: Only source primary keys and release provenance are required; missing source values stay null.

value: All rows of the selected upstream generation; publisher collection completeness is not established.
member_key remains authoritative when bioguide_id is missing; vote totals do not imply recorded individual ballots.

value.meaning: Exact published source key; missing profile rows remain unresolved.
value.scope: All selected detail rows, including subjects outside local profiles
